notablePrerequisites: You've drawn two or more cards this turn.
description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Kydele.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kydele.
Repeat.
